rationale: Read complete actual importer/decoder bundle and stat/read-stream seams. Uses one real valid transcript that grows to 17MiB after observed stat, controls only discovery/journal/filesystem observation, and compares actual before/fixed importer outcomes without copied quota logic. Cleans stream/file scratch. Current importer intentionally evolved to bounded retained newest-window rather than this historical total-source quota, so exact transform rejects.

cases.title: before importer accepts grown source and replaces epoch
cases.reason: Actual importer/decoder without consumed-byte quota must see original stat, close stream, return success and call journal replacement once. Full consumed-byte total is measured, not asserted.

cases.title: fixed historical importer refuses grown source and preserves prior journal
cases.reason: Actual historical quota path must close stream, return refusal and never invoke journal replacement. Exact consumed-byte overshoot/source size/epoch values are reported, not independent assertions.
